content.title: About
content.content: Reduced‑fat flavored tortilla chips are crisp pieces made from corn tortillas that are baked or air‑fried with less oil. They carry a light seasoning (such as cheese, barbecue, or spicy chili) and are a convenient low‑calorie snack.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Tortilla chips originated in Mexico as a way to use leftover tortilla dough.
Reduced fat is achieved by air‑frying technology instead of deep‑frying.
Flavor blends often rely on natural spices and extracts, without artificial colors.
Corn, the base ingredient, is rich in antioxidant carotenoids.
Tortilla chips are commonly served with guacamole, salsa, or yogurt‑based dips.

items.title: Lower fat content
items.content: The reduced amount of oil makes them more suitable for calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Corn tortillas provide slowly digestible carbs that help maintain steady energy levels.

items.title: Provides B‑vitamins
items.content: Tortilla chips supply thiamine, niacin, and folate, which are important for metabolism.

items.title: Gluten‑free when made from corn
items.content: Suitable for people with gluten intolerance if the product is certified gluten‑free.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some flavored varieties can be high in salt; choose low‑sodium options if you monitor sodium intake.

items.title: Corn allergy
items.content: Rare, but a corn allergy can cause reactions.

items.title: Loss of crunch if stored improperly
items.content: Moisture can make chips soft and promote mold growth.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy tortilla chips as a snack on their own, with dips (salsa, guacamole, yogurt dip), or incorporate them into dishes such as chili, salads, or as a crunchy topping for casseroles.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a sealed package in a cool, dry place. After opening, reseal tightly or transfer to an airtight container to maintain crispness. Discard if you notice off‑flavors or a soggy texture.
